intro: Country life, plants and animals, and the proverbs the countryside left in the language.
p.cosecha.consejo: You say «recoger la cosecha». A good cosecha is a good amount of crops.
p.sembrar.consejo: The e becomes ie: «siembro», «siembras». The saying goes: «quien siembra recoge».
p.semilla.consejo: The ll sounds like y: se-MI-ya. It is sown in spring.
p.cultivar.consejo: You grow tomatoes, wheat or flowers. You can also cultivate a friendship.
p.huerta.consejo: The h is silent: WER-ta. A huerta is larger than a huerto; Valencia has a famous one.
p.granja.consejo: It is written with j: GRAN-ha. It has hens, cows or pigs.
p.ganado.consejo: It is singular although there are many animals: «el ganado pasta». Cows, sheep and pigs are livestock.
p.rebaño.consejo: The ñ sounds ny: rre-BA-nyo. A shepherd looks after it.
p.pastor.consejo: Feminine: «la pastora». It comes from «pastar», grazing.
p.seta.consejo: Some can be eaten and some cannot. People who gather them «va de setas».
p.florecer.consejo: It is conjugated like «conocer»: «florezco», «floreces». Almond trees flower in spring.
p.madurar.consejo: It is also said of people: «madurar» is to grow up inside. It comes from «maduro».
p.silvestre.consejo: It is said of plants and fruit: «flores silvestres». For animals you say «salvaje».
p.venenoso.consejo: It comes from «veneno». Some mushrooms are poisonous: do not pick them without knowing.
b1.texto:
**Growing.** The farmer **siembra** (sows) **semillas** (seeds), waters, **cultiva** and months later gathers the **cosecha**. A **huerta** is irrigated land with vegetables and fruit trees; a «huerto» is smaller.

**Animals.** A **granja** has hens, pigs and cows. **Ganado** is all the animals raised for work or food. A **rebaño** of sheep is looked after by a **pastor**.

**Plants.** A plant sprouts, **florece**, bears fruit and the fruit **madura**. There are bushes, **setas** and **silvestres** plants; some are **venenosas**.

**Character.** An animal is tame or fierce; domestic or wild. A native species is one belonging to a place.

**Country sayings.** **Quien siembra vientos recoge tempestades** (you reap what you sow). **Cada oveja con su pareja** (birds of a feather). **Ser la oveja negra** (to be the black sheep). **Estar verde** (to be unprepared).
b2.f0.texto: When do you sow the seeds in the garden?
b2.f1.texto: We sow them in March, when the last frosts pass.
b2.f3.texto: At the end of summer we can already pick the tomatoes.
b2.f4.texto: My uncle looks after a flock of sheep in the mountains.
b2.f5.texto: A good shepherd knows every corner of the hill.
b2.f6.texto: He also knows which mushrooms are poisonous.
b2.f7.texto: Wild flowers bloom without anyone looking after them.
b4.texto:
**Quien** + verb means «the person who»: **Quien siembra recoge.** It is the typical form of proverbs, which state a general truth in few words.

Other country sayings:

- **Cada oveja con su pareja.**
- **A buenas horas, mangas verdes.** (too late)

And idioms: **ser la oveja negra** (to be different from the rest) and **estar verde** (to be unprepared).
b4.e0.texto: Whoever sows the wind reaps the whirlwind.
b4.e1.texto: Each sheep looks for its partner.
b4.e2.texto: My cousin is the black sheep of the family.
b5.f0.texto: At dawn, my grandmother's garden smells of wet earth and mint.
b5.f1.texto: She walks between the furrows with a wicker basket on her arm.
b5.f2.texto: Each seed she sowed in spring is now a green, strong plant.
b5.f3.texto: The tomato plants are covered with small yellow flowers.
b5.f4.texto: A sparrow hops from branch to branch and watches grandmother with curiosity.
b5.f5.texto: When the sun warms them, the tomatoes ripen slowly and turn red.
b5.f6.texto: Grandmother gathers the day's harvest and shares it out in coloured baskets.
b5.f7.texto: Among the wild bushes on the bank grows an orange mushroom.
b5.f8.texto: Grandmother looks at the mushroom from afar and warns the children that it is poisonous.
b5.f9.texto: At the end of the afternoon, the garden falls silent, full of smells and long shadows.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Before sowing there is nothing yet to gather.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Yes: it is gathered when the fruit is ripe.
b6.o2.refuerzo: If the land rests, there are no plants to gather.
b7.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «florecer» is when a plant puts out flowers.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Madurar» is said of fruit, not flowers.
b8.frase: Este año la cosecha ha sido mejor
b8.traduccion: This year the harvest has been better
b9.o0.refuerzo: Sowing a garden is the work of a gardener.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Selling tomatoes is a greengrocer's work.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Yes: the shepherd looks after a flock of sheep or goats.
b11.frase: Estas setas son ____: no las comas.
b11.o0.refuerzo: «Manso» is said of calm animals, not mushrooms.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «venenosas» means they harm you if eaten.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Maduro» is said of ripe fruit, not a dangerous mushroom.
b11.pregunta: Which adjective explains why they are not eaten?
b12.o0: ser distinto del resto de la familia
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it is the one who does not fit in with the others.
b12.o1.refuerzo: It is not about real sheep, but about a person.
b12.o2.refuerzo: It is not about a trade, but about being different.
b12.pregunta: What does «ser la oveja negra» mean?
p.silvestres.consejo: The v sounds like «b». Stress on BES.
p.florecen.consejo: Plural of «florece». The c before e sounds like «th».
p.cuide.consejo: Used after «sin que»: «sin que nadie las cuide».
p.vientos.consejo: Masculine plural: «el viento». The v sounds like «b».
p.recoge.consejo: The g before e sounds like «h»: re-KO-khe.
p.oveja.consejo: Feminine: «la oveja». The j sounds like «h».
p.primo.consejo: The feminine is «prima», with a different ending.
p.hierbabuena.consejo: The h is silent and the bu is heard: yer-ba-BWE-na.
p.surcos.consejo: Masculine plural: «el surco». The c before o sounds like «k».
p.cesto.consejo: Masculine: «el cesto». The c before e sounds like «th».
p.mimbre.consejo: Masculine. The b sounds soft, like «v».
p.primavera.consejo: Feminine: «la primavera». The v sounds like «b».
p.gorrión.consejo: The initial r is strong. Masculine: «el gorrión».
p.observa.consejo: «Observar» means to watch carefully. Stress on SER.
p.matas.consejo: Feminine plural: «la mata». Stress on MA.
p.avisa.consejo: «Avisar» means to warn or inform. The v sounds like «b».
p.venenosa.consejo: Feminine of «venenoso». The v sounds like «b».
p.olores.consejo: Masculine plural: «el olor». Stress on LO.
p.almendros.consejo: Masculine plural: «el almendro». The stress is on MEN.
p.sembráis.consejo: Used with «vosotros». The accent falls on the last syllable.
p.semillas.consejo: The ll sounds like y: se-MI-yas. Feminine: «la semilla».
p.sembramos.consejo: Here the e does not change to ie, because the stress is not on it.
p.finales.consejo: «A finales de» means towards the end of: «a finales de verano».
p.ovejas.consejo: Plural of «oveja». The v sounds like b and the j like h.
p.monte.consejo: It is masculine: «el monte». It is wild land, not a cultivated field.
p.setas.consejo: Feminine plural of «seta». Some can be eaten and some are poisonous.
